label: Paint Finish
description: How the primary color behaves in light — from light-swallowing matte to poured-mercury gloss.

items.name: matte
items.text: matte finish, a zero-gloss surface that swallows reflections so the body reads as pure sculpted form

items.name: glossy-high-reflectance
items.text: deep gloss finish, high-reflectance clear coat stretching crisp mirror highlights along every panel line

items.name: satin-sheen
items.text: satin finish, a soft directional sheen that follows the body curvature without hard reflections

items.name: metallic-flake
items.text: metallic-flake paint, coarse aluminum sparkle shifting grain by grain as the light moves

items.name: pearlescent
items.text: pearlescent paint, mica underglow flipping between warm and cool as the panels turn

items.name: color-shifting-iridescent
items.text: iridescent color-shift paint, the hue sliding across the spectrum between highlight and shadow

items.name: liquid-metal
items.text: liquid-metal finish, mirror-smooth as poured mercury, reflections running unbroken across the body

items.name: chameleon-flip
items.text: chameleon flip paint, its two-tone color flop splitting sharply along each character line

items.name: anodized-matte
items.text: anodized matte metal finish, fine-grained satin with a machined aerospace tone

items.name: panther-black-matte
items.text: panther-black matte, a light-absorbing velvet black that turns the body into pure silhouette
